help.title: Help Guide
help.whatItDoesText: This tool processes your Consolidated Transaction Report (CTR) and generates formatted Poliza Ledger Excel files, one per Company Code.
help.selectFileText: Click the upload area or drag and drop your CTR Excel file.
help.processFileText: Click the Process File button. The system will automatically process all Company Codes.
help.downloadResultsText: Once processing is complete, download the ZIP file containing one Excel per Company Code.
help.expectedStructureText: Standard CTR layout with Company Code column
help.formatText: Standard CTR export format from the system
help.noDataText: Check that the file has data starting at the expected row.
help.invalidFormatText: Ensure the file is a CTR export with the standard column layout.
help.processingFailedText: Verify all required columns are present in the file.
help.structureRecognizedText: The tool uses row 27 as headers and row 28 as data start by default.
help.needMoreHelpText: Contact your system administrator if you continue to experience issues.
